job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Engine Infrastructure
job.workplace: In office Tuesday–Thursday; Monday and Friday optional
job.pay_full: $243,290 – $295,250 a year starting base pay (San Mateo headquarters), plus eligibility for equity

details.about: Tens of millions of people use Roblox every day to explore, create, play and connect in 3D experiences built by its community of developers and creators. This Senior Software Engineer joins the Systems team on the Game Engine side, working on the building blocks of Roblox itself: a very large C++ application used by more than 2 million developers, touching everything from threading and memory management to physics and scripting.
duties: Develop C++ engine code for sub-systems critical to the Roblox game engine
Work on server-client data syncing, game-aware data streaming and balancing resource use so gameplay runs on devices with different CPU and memory capabilities
Work across every Roblox application, from mobile clients to cloud-based servers
needs: 4+ years of experience working on deep, challenging problems in large and complex C++ codebases
Comfort with system-level pointers, templates and raw memory
Experience inside a game engine, or a passion for learning one
A record of building systems that keep working reliably
Curiosity to keep learning and stay current with technology
details.benefits: Starting base pay $243,290 – $295,250 a year for roles at the San Mateo, CA headquarters; actual pay depends on background, experience, location and other factors. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and benefits.
notes: Office-based roles are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, with Monday and Friday optional
Roblox may not be able to employ candidates with work authorization tied to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship, for this role
